topic: July 1969: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon, and Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on it.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Moonprint Mystery

shots.narration: Golden sparkles, blue flashes—where did the ground go?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation; gray lunar ground beneath a black sky, bright sunlight, swirling golden time-jump sparkles.
shots.action: Zoya materializes beside Tock just above the dusty ground.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue glow, golden glitter, wide-eyed surprise.

shots.narration: Zoya and Tock have reached the Moon!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit lunar hollow; Zoya wears a transparent sealed spacesuit over her yellow hoodie and cargo shorts, with her black ponytail visible.
shots.action: Zoya settles her space boots onto the gray surface.
shots.mood: Bright silver terrain, friendly wonder, crisp shadows.

shots.narration: [excited] It's July 1969, and Apollo 11 has landed here!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic lunar hollow; a low dusty ridge blocks the horizon, with a small glint of gold beyond it.
shots.action: Tock points toward the distant gold glint.
shots.mood: Sunlit dust, gleaming brass, eager curiosity.

shots.narration: But this ridge hides the landing site.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, base of a gently sloping lunar ridge, gray rocks and sharply defined shadows.
shots.action: Zoya stretches upward to peer over the ridge.
shots.mood: Playful frustration, raised eyebrows, bright sunlight.

shots.narration: Zoya spots a gentle path around it.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, curved open route beside the lunar ridge, clear of rocks and footprints.
shots.action: Zoya points along the open route.
shots.mood: Clear inviting path, hopeful smiles, warm helmet reflections.

shots.narration: [giggles] Tock's tiny legs are ready for exploring!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of untouched gray lunar soil beside the ridge; Tock has a brass body, glass face, and spring tail.
shots.action: Tock takes an exaggerated step along the path.
shots.mood: Bouncy pose, cheerful glass face, sparkling brass.

shots.narration: Around the ridge, something golden comes into view.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, ridge opening onto Apollo 11's lunar module, gold-colored foil and landing legs, without visible lettering, flags, or logos.
shots.action: Zoya rounds the edge of the ridge.
shots.mood: Spectacular sunlit reveal, shining gold against gray terrain.

shots.narration: There it is: Apollo 11's lunar lander.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide lunar landing site; unmarked gold-and-silver lunar module in the background, no astronauts visible.
shots.action: Tock raises his tiny arms toward the lander.
shots.mood: Triumphant discovery, bright metallic reflections, welcoming adventure.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of patterned astronaut bootprints near the lunar module; Zoya stands on untouched ground beside them.
shots.mood: Quiet amazement, delicate dust texture, soft blue watch glow.

shots.narration: Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the Moon.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic close-up of astronaut boot impressions in gray lunar dust, with a lander footpad softly visible behind them; no people or lettering.
shots.action: The camera reveals a trail of bootprints across the dust.
shots.mood: Respectful wonder, crisp sunlight, extraordinary detail.

shots.narration: Zoya leaves the historic footprints untouched.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, lunar landing site with historic bootprints clearly separated from Zoya and Tock's route.
shots.action: Zoya steps back onto her own path.
shots.mood: Satisfied smiles, careful discovery, golden lander gleaming behind them.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit lunar ridge; Zoya's blue wristwatch glows as golden time-travel sparkles gather around both travelers.
shots.action: Tock tilts his round glass face toward Zoya's glowing watch.
shots.mood: Eager eyes, brilliant blue light, swirling golden anticipation.

episode.endHook: The blue watch sparkles again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock time-jump to the Moon in July 1969! A dusty ridge hides their discovery as they explore Apollo 11’s landing and learn about Neil Armstrong’s first steps.
